name: ChatGPT AI Product Description
summary: Bulk copy generator for Shopify from Profitonium: product descriptions, titles, meta tags and image alt text for thousands of products at once, in 30+ languages, with custom instruction templates and automatic descriptions on import. Live since 2021.
best_for: Shopify stores with catalogues in the thousands that need descriptions, titles, meta tags and alt text written in bulk and in several languages, and have the discipline to check a sample before running the whole catalogue
skip_if: you have a small catalogue where 100 free credits a month already covers the new arrivals, or your product copy is a differentiator you would rather write by hand
honest_knock:
First, the name is not a name. 'ChatGPT AI Product Description' described a category (the listing has since been renamed AI Product Description-ChatGPT), the app's own listing copy now calls itself Descrii AI Product Descriptions, and Shopify shows a different app by a different developer under a nearly identical name on the same page. Check the developer is Profitonium before you install.

Second, the credit is undefined and it is the only thing you are buying. Four tiers, one variable, no definition, and the '$1 per 100 descriptions' line that the three paid plans repeated on 20 September 2026 was not the rate on two of them (by 17 November 2026 the listing had replaced it with add on credits at 100 credits per $1). Worse, the plan price may not be the whole bill: the listing carries Shopify's usage-based-charges line, and a merchant of twelve months, in a review edited 30 July 2026, itemised charges of $586.79, $487.49, $282.69 and $483.16 on top of a stated $149 a year plus $49 a month, marked 'billing cycle ended' and 'fee threshold reached'. That is one public account and the developer has not answered it on the listing, but nothing on the page lets you rule it out either.

Third, and the one that costs real money: this app edits your live store. Its permissions cover product descriptions and titles, Online Store pages and theme, files, locales, Shopify Markets settings, translations and navigation, and nothing on the listing describes versioning, a preview queue or a rollback. On 15 September 2026 a merchant of five months reported that it changed titles to products the store does not carry; the developer replied the next day that he had paused automatic generation for that store and was adding safeguards. The 525 ratings read on 17 November 2026 are strong, 499 five stars, but three are one star and they are the ones that describe undoing. Export your product CSV before the first bulk run. That is your rollback.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on apps.shopify.com/automated-description-writing and in our own test that day; earlier: re-verified 2026-09-20 on apps.shopify.com/automated-description-writing) Four tiers, priced in credits per month, all amounts unchanged since 19 August 2026. Free Trial: 100 credits a month. Basic $19 a month or $190 a year (save 17%): 2,000 credits, product descriptions, titles and meta descriptions, formatted descriptions, automatic descriptions on import. Standard $49 or $399 a year (save 32%): 11,000 credits, same features. Pro $249 or $1,990 a year (save 33%): 110,000 credits, same features plus priority video-call support. Every paid card repeated 'Only $1 per 100 Descriptions' on 20 September 2026, which only held at the bottom of the ladder: $19 for 2,000 credits is 95 cents per hundred, $49 for 11,000 is 45 cents, $249 for 110,000 is 23 cents. The listing never says what a title, a meta description or an alt text costs in credits. It also carries the standard line that recurring AND USAGE-BASED charges are billed every 30 days, and no usage rate or threshold is published anywhere on the page. The app's own copy then called it 'Descrii AI Product Descriptions' while the listing title still read 'ChatGPT AI Product Description'; by 17 November 2026 the listing and the app were both titled AI Product Description-ChatGPT; the Works-with row names Claude, Gemini, GPT-5, gpt 5 mini and grok. Developer Profitonium, Adugodi, Bangalore; launched 12 March 2021; Built for Shopify badge; 4.9 from 529 ratings. Read again on 17 November 2026: the listing, now titled AI Product Description-ChatGPT, shows the same four plans at the same amounts ($19 or $190 a year, $49 or $399, $249 or $1,990, and the free card with 100 credits a month), at 4.9 from 525 ratings. The 'Only $1 per 100 Descriptions' line was no longer on the cards. They now say add on credits cost 100 credits per $1 with a $5 minimum and that credit usage varies by AI model and features, and the Standard card also names a Catalog plan at $129 a month or $1,188 a year with 40,000 credits a month; our September reading recorded neither. The listing's Works with row names Claude, Gemini, GPT-5 mini, GPT-5 and grok. In our own test the same day on a Shopify development store the app opened on a Choose a plan screen. Monthly it showed Basic $19 (2,000 credits, about 1,000 descriptions), Standard $49 (11,000 credits) and Pro $249 (110,000 credits); on its default annual view it showed $15, $33 and $165 a month, which are the listing's yearly prices spread over twelve months and rounded down, with 50% more credits. A Free plan at $0 with 100 credits a month sat below the paid plans and started with no card and no Shopify approval screen. The Catalog plan was not on that screen, and the paywall said GPT-6 where the listing says GPT-5. One product description cost 2 credits, shown before we generated it, and the credit balance went from 100 to 98; the extra generation types (ads, collection descriptions, Instagram captions, product benefits) needed Standard or Pro. We did not publish the output to the product.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested the app AI Product Description-ChatGPT (ChatGPT AI Product Description in the dossier) on a Shopify development store: the install, the three sample descriptions the app wrote by itself about 1 minute after the install without any step, one own generation for the Demo Mug with its cost of 2 credits shown first and a result after about 8 seconds (general and short, not wrong, not saved), the credit estimates for the whole store, the paywall with monthly prices equal to the listing and annual prices that differ in form, the Free plan with 100 credits and no card, and the uninstall, which asks for a reason. The app made a collection that was deleted afterwards. Nothing was paid or saved. Install: the listing apps.shopify.com/automated-description-writing (developer Profitonium) is now titled AI Product Description-ChatGPT; the dossier calls it ChatGPT AI Product Description. The app is the same product. The install form was sent at 23:00:11 in our own tab and Install was clicked on the permission screen (View staff and contributor data, View and edit store data: Products, Online Store, Shopify admin). No account, card or phone number was asked. First result: right after the install the app opened on Review your AI-generated content with Your AI descriptions are ready! and 3 of 3 completed. Three descriptions were already written, without any action: Appointment, Build Your Snowboard Gift Box and Bundle Product #1. It says This is just a sneak peek! You can generate for all your products later. This took about 1 minute (about 23:01) and 0 own steps after the install, and cost no credits (100 before and after). Quality of the three samples, read by hand: Appointment went from Appointment to Make time for what matters with an appointment. Keep your scheduled visit in mind and plan your day around it., which is filler and states no facts. Build Your Snowboard Gift Box kept the 15% from the original text (Save 15%: Pay less than you would buying your selected products separately.) and added no features we could see. Bundle Product #1 had no description and got Bundle Product #1 is a bundle product., which says nothing. Own generation: Bulk Generation, Demo Mug ticked, Description on, showed Generation cost: 2 credits before the click, then Generate 1 items. After about 8 seconds the result stood in Product generation history (order a001e, 1/1 Generated, 0/1 Saved): The Demo Mug gives you a plain, straightforward mug for enjoying a drink at your desk or table. Its simple look fits easily into an everyday routine without adding extra decoration. Use it for coffee, tea, or another drink when you want a no-frills mug. The original text was A plain demo mug. The text matches the input (plain) and invents no material, content or size, with a little filler (desk or table, coffee or tea). It is general and thin, but not wrong. Credits went from 100 to 98, 2 per description as shown. Nothing was saved to the product; Demo Mug still reads A plain demo mug (checked in Shopify). Dashboard: Product descriptions 20 missing or under 40 words, Generation estimate 40 credits; SEO titles 17 missing, 34 credits; SEO descriptions 18 missing, 36 credits; Credits left 98, Enough for 49 more descriptions. Side effect: the app made a collection All Products (AI Product Description-ChatGPT) with 23 products (condition price above or below $0,01); it was deleted after the test. Plans: after Continue the page Choose a plan (a paywall) shows, monthly, Basic $19 a month (Billed USD 19 every 30 days, 2,000 credits, about 1,000 GPT-6 descriptions, 3,000 with annual billing), Standard $49 a month (11,000 credits, 16,500 with annual billing) and PRO $249 a month (110,000 credits, 165,000 with annual billing); these monthly prices equal the listing. Annual (Save up to 33%) is selected by default and shows $15, $33 and $165 a month with 3,000, 16,500 and 165,000 credits (PRO plus 50% credits); the listing names $190, $399 and $1,990 a year, which does not divide to those monthly figures, and the yearly total was not seen on a Shopify screen. The listing also names a Catalog plan ($129/mo or $1,188/yr, 40k credits/mo), which was not on the paywall, and Add-on credits (100 credits per $1, $5 minimum), which was not seen in the app (only an Add Credits button, not opened). The paywall says GPT-6 descriptions where the listing names GPT-5. Below the paid plans: Free Plan $0 a month, 100 credits every month, Continue with Free. Checkout: Continue with Free was chosen (URL plan FREE, Credits renew Dec 17, 2026); no card, no payment screen and no Shopify approval screen came up, so no paid checkout was seen and no paid plan was clicked. Extra Generations (Ads, Collection Descriptions, Instagram Captions, Product Benefits) says You need to upgrade your plan to "STANDARD" or "PRO" to use this feature. Cancelling: no paid plan was started, so there was nothing to cancel. Settings, Apps, the app menu and Uninstall opened the dialog Uninstall AI Product Description-ChatGPT? (you will no longer be able to use the app; a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information) with a required Reason for uninstalling (Testing multiple apps was chosen); the app then left the Installed list. Not tested: paid plans, Add Credits, saving to Shopify, a batch of thousands of products, automatic descriptions on import, translations, image and web search, the blog writer, the SEO audit, Brand Voice, the chat assistant, and the extra costs that customer reviews mention. Clean up: the app was uninstalled, the collection the app made was deleted, no product, description or theme was changed, the plan stayed Free with 98 credits and nothing was paid. Our own tab was closed. The price fields are not changed here. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The text for a product with little input stays general and thin (a plain mug got a plain mug text; a product without a description got a sentence that says nothing). The annual prices on the paywall do not match the yearly prices on the listing and annual is selected by default. The listing names a Catalog plan and add-on credits that were not seen, and the paywall says GPT-6 where the listing says GPT-5. The app also makes a collection of all products in the store, which has to be removed by hand.
